answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 25004 Country: India Title: Kya islaam mai mannat mangna haraam hai shirk hai? or kya baqra eid per nar baqre ki qurbani karna haraam hai jabki muje maloom hua hai ki haj ke duraan nar baqre ki hi qurbani di jati hai. Question: Kya islaam mai mannat mangna haraam hai shirk hai? or kya baqra eid per nar baqre ki qurbani karna haraam hai jabki muje maloom hua hai ki haj ke duraan nar baqre ki hi qurbani di jati hai. Answer ID: 25004 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1370/1370/M=1431) (1) It is unlawful and haram to make a vow of unlawful and sinful deed. However, it is right to make a vow of lawful deed. (2) The qurbani of he-goat is lawful. The ruling of its lawfulness is available in the books of Fiqh and fatawa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
